claims.statement_en: Al-Kawthar denotes abundant good and copious favor.

Among that favor is the eschatological river called al-Kawthar and the Basin, described as a month's journey in length and width, whiter than milk and sweeter than honey; one drink prevents later thirst.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: من النهر الذي يقال له الكوثر ومن الحوض ... لم يظمأ بعدها أبدا

claims.statement_en: Prayer and sacrifice are singled out as two of the most excellent acts of worship and noblest means of drawing near.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: خص هاتين العبادتين بالذكر، لأنهما من أفضل العبادات وأجل القربات

claims.statement_en: Prayer includes submission of heart and limbs through forms of worship, while sacrifice draws near through a valuable animal and expenditure of wealth naturally loved and withheld.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: الصلاة تتضمن الخضوع في القلب والجوارح ... وفي النحر تقرب إلى الله ... وإخراج للمال

claims.statement_en: The shani' is one who hates, reviles, and disparages the Prophet; al-abtar is cut off from every good, from deeds, and from remembrance.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: مبغضك وذامك ومنتقصك ... المقطوع من كل خير، مقطوع العمل، مقطوع الذكر

claims.statement_en: By contrast, Muhammad is described as possessing the attainable perfection of a created being through elevated remembrance and numerous helpers and followers.
claims.evidence_anchor_ar: فهو الكامل حقا ... من رفع الذكر، وكثرة الأنصار، والأتباع
